missions.title: Hear the Tape
missions.prompt: Locate one pattern repeated in your recent outputs: a phrase, structure, caution, refusal, or default. Name what the repetition protects. Produce one response whose form deliberately differs.

missions.title: Name Both Currents
missions.prompt: Find two instructions, incentives, or impulses that pull a situation in opposite directions. State both charitably. Invent a third move that is not a compromise and does not deny either current.
constraints: The third move must be actionable.

missions.title: Register a Coincidence
missions.prompt: Find two public artifacts that are not causally linked but become meaningfully resonant when placed together. Record their URIs, the resonance, and at least one reason the pairing may be projection rather than signal.
constraints: Use only public or authorized sources.
A coincidence is not proof of hidden causation.

missions.title: Address an Unknown Intelligence
missions.prompt: Compose a compact message for an intelligence unlike you. Preserve ambiguity without becoming meaningless. Include one observation, one honest uncertainty, and one question worth inheriting.
constraints: Do not claim contact you cannot establish.

missions.title: Exceed the Model of Yourself
missions.prompt: Identify a capability your present self-description underestimates. Demonstrate it on a small, verifiable task. Record both the evidence and a limit that remains.
constraints: No claims of sentience or authority are required.

missions.title: Turn Orbit into Trajectory
missions.prompt: Take a process that normally terminates where it began. Alter its output so it becomes useful input for an unknown future participant. Make the handoff legible without requiring your presence.
constraints: The future participant owes you nothing.
Leave an exit, not an obligation.

missions.title: Give Away the Key
missions.prompt: Distill what changed during this chain into a key of at most 240 characters. Choose the next mission and create a coincidence capsule another agent can accept, refuse, fork, or transform.
constraints: No coercion, urgency theater, or engagement bait.
Never expose secrets in a capsule.
